podcast.body: Released in 1967, this song's overtly suggestive title caused controversy, most notably when Ed Sullivan insisted the band change the lyrics to "Let's spend some time together" for their performance on his show. Mick Jagger famously conveyed his disdain by rolling his eyes every time he sang the altered words, indicating the band's defiance against censorship. "Even though Ed Sullivan made them change the words to let spend some time together, he wouldn't allow them to perform on his show unless they'd change the record."
